preview.scope: Visualization only; exact STEP geometry remains authoritative.

interfaces.coil_outline_convention: the published 60 mm coil diameter is the OUTER EDGE of the patterned copper; every spiral parameter here is that outer edge (spiral_ribbon starts its centreline at outer_edge - width/2), so no copper leaves the declared outline
interfaces.frame: +Z out of the body towards the wearable transmitter, z=0 at the skin surface, origin on the coaxial transmitter/receiver axis; receiver at z<0
not_modelled: component cavities in the ecoflex cover (the 1.0 mm component layer is the cavity body rx_ecoflex_interstitial_fill)

strain field, bending radius, twist and fatigue: this source is static size parameters only, so the published 0-50% strain / 2 cm bend radius / 3-turn twist / 5000-cycle figures are NOT modelled, parameterised or reproduced

native_readback.scope: Solver output integrity only; no circuit acceptance or calibration.

model_input_reuse.scope: Original immutable SPICE model/output only; mechanical/source calibration and joint applicability remain unverified.

interfaces.boundary_in: VIN is driven by an equivalent DC source (VDC=4 V, RSRC=2 ohm); the rectifier, the coils and the transmitter are NOT modelled
interfaces.boundary_out: VOUT -> 24 mW average MCU load (published); burst profile is a self-built assumption
interfaces.coverage_of_published_budget: 204 of 240 mW (85%); the 36 mW rectifier part is outside the boundary
interfaces.domain: DC/energy domain only (no RF model in this deck)

nodes.src: ideal DC source node (boundary equivalent of the rectifier output)
nodes.vin: DC-link storage node; the rectifier interface
nodes.vout: regulated 3.3 V rail feeding the MCU load
nodes.vreg: regulator internal output (after the dropout-limited pass element)

interfaces.not_a_system_claim: a local supply-stage solution is not evidence that the harvesting system works or is variation-tolerant

published_anchor.source: Supplementary Note 5 p.12 and Supplementary Note 7 p.13

unknowns_kept_explicit: device models of the actual BOM parts
transmitter class-E operating point and 11 V cell discharge

evaluation.scope: Exact native file/build readback only; source semantics, functional checks and complete product acceptance remain separate.

delivery_integrity.scope: Actual listed file hashes and native input/assembly version; functional and product acceptance remain separate.
